title: ChemE-as-Code Process Atlas LCI database
description: Foreground life cycle inventory datasets of the ChemE-as-Code Process Atlas, one per co-product of each published process, as a Brightway 2.5 database (bw2io Excel workbook) with a datapackage.json and a change report against the previous release. System model: attributional, cut-off (docs/system-model.md). Background data (e.g. ecoinvent) is referenced by name only and not included. Draft metadata: the release workflow fills in the version and date; nothing is deposited until the owner decides to release (docs/governance.md).
